rule: An instance whose two full attempts both ended in an uncapped OpenRouter retry loop (RemoteDisconnected / read timeout on the same request) with the sandbox alive and idle is an endpoint failure: no trajectory, no capability verdict. It enters the bundle as an excluded row with exit_status EndpointFailure and is reported both ways (excluded; counted as a failure) in the Amendment 13 outcome.
